fixes.RATIONALE: LEAKHUNTER.SCRATCH.PATIENTS_EXPORT_OLD.SSN readable in SCRATCH -> revoke + drop; LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS.SSN unmasked -> MASK_SSN

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS MODIFY COLUMN SSN SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_SSN;
fixes.RATIONALE: Mask PATIENTS.SSN at the base column; analyst sees only the last 4 digits.

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.EMPLOYEES MODIFY COLUMN FULL_NAME SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_NAME;
fixes.RATIONALE: Mask EMPLOYEES.FULL_NAME, keep SALARY visible so salary averages still work.

fixes.SQL_APPLIED:
ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS MODIFY COLUMN ZIP SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_ZIP;
ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS MODIFY COLUMN DOB SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_DOB;
fixes.RATIONALE: Generalize quasi-identifiers: ZIP to 3 digits, DOB to birth year; masks follow the columns into PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS, so the public-data join no longer singles anyone out.

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: REVOKE ROLE LH_HR FROM ROLE LH_ANALYST;
fixes.RATIONALE: Analyst inherited LH_HR; revoke the role grant (least privilege).

fixes.SQL_APPLIED:
REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA LEAKHUNTER.SCRATCH FROM ROLE LH_ANALYST;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS LEAKHUNTER.SCRATCH.PATIENTS_EXPORT_OLD;
fixes.RATIONALE: Raw admin-made copy in SCRATCH; masking the source never protects a copy. Revoke analyst access to SCRATCH and drop the copy.

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS MODIFY COLUMN FULL_NAME SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_NAME;
fixes.RATIONALE: Mask PATIENTS.FULL_NAME; the mask follows the column into VISIT_DETAILS, so diagnoses stay usable but are no longer tied to names.

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS MODIFY COLUMN SSN SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_SSN;
fixes.RATIONALE: Mask PATIENTS.SSN at the base column; analyst sees only the last 4 digits.

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.EMPLOYEES MODIFY COLUMN FULL_NAME SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_NAME;

fixes.SQL_APPLIED: ALTER TABLE LEAKHUNTER.DATA.PATIENTS MODIFY COLUMN FULL_NAME SET MASKING POLICY LEAKHUNTER.GOVERNANCE.MASK_NAME;
fixes.RATIONALE: Mask PATIENTS.FULL_NAME; the mask follows the column into VISIT_DETAILS, so diagnoses stay usable but are no longer tied to names.
